items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ever know a guy named Joshua Altheim over there? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, I've heard of him, I don't know of him.

ctx.x: Oh, about 200 miles or more. Oh,
from a good ways off. That's right. Ever know a guy named Joshua Altheim over there? Played piano, used to play with Washboard Sam a lot?
Oh, I've heard of him, I don't know of him.
